reviews.review_description: This game is actually surprisingly good, regarding the reviews. But, theres a couple of bugs that ive noticed. The random pitch selection doesnt work that well, it only throws fastballs and strikes, if you want balls you need to change pitch location. The tag fly also doesnt work. I would reccomend fixing these bugs and what will be cool is making a game play mode where you can umpire a real game. And you can select high school, collage, and pro.
Love this   It is just a way to get in some pitch to one I. The off season

This is a great app for younger officials coming in to call wider variations of age levels in little league. An umpire must always be aware of what’s going on around and especially with the younger kids, due to the different play styles, pitch styles and kids generally not knowing the rules. 

Even with only you as a developer you have done a great job and I can’t wait to see how this app progresses. 

Also Umpires should not be judging where the catchers glove is cause that means you are either trusting their framing or not seeing where the ball crosses the plate. Don’t listen to him. Although dealing with framing would be nice.

reviews.review_title: I am a HS baseball umpire
reviews.review_description: As an umpire, it is essential to judge where the ball hits the catcher’s glove. In this “game” the catcher doesn’t move at all, taking away from the realism. Also, I could not figure out how to remove the huge menu that covers the entire outfield. Great idea, poorly executed. These poor quality apps are ruining VR.
I couldn't get past the I understand screen. Please advise this seems like a good idea. I hope it works well soon.

It’s a great idea, and could be very helpful for umpires to train in the offseason or between games. Right now, it’s a bit clunky and crashes quite a bit. I wasn’t able to get the plays at 1B to start as it would lock up every time, but the calls behind home weren’t too bad. Like I said, it’s a work in progress.

Downloaded app this afternoon.  Worked fine. Good enough to use with new umpires.  Went to show another board member couple hours later and get error that the app has been modified manually. 
Only modification was the levers within the app that allow for speed change and location etc. As well as right or left handed batter
